source_method: Independent local PyMuPDF page text and position extraction of original private PDF; program number at x<20 matched to horse-name heading at x≈36 by page y-coordinate; 80/80 entries uniquely resolved
digest_algorithm: sha256 over ascending numeric program rows, each row program:normalized_horse_name, joined with LF, no final newline; normalized=NFKD, remove combining marks, lowercase, strip non a-z0-9
limitations: No private PDF or full horse-name list committed; digests prove roster equality only if independently sourced source PDF is trusted.
Digest parity is not proof of actual starter status, complete pace data, official charts, or independently anchored prospective predictions.
The production pdfjs importer replay is still required; this manifest does not claim it was executed.
